resources.string: Connect an OpenGD77 radio over USB (OTG). Identification, screen and clock only.

OpenGD77 has no tuning CAT over USB: the firmware accepts no frequency, mode, channel or PTT commands. The radio computes Doppler itself in its Satellite menu from its keps and clock; here you can set that clock to UTC. The Flash is never written.
Clock sent: %1$s UTC. Reopen the Satellite menu to recalculate passes.
No USB CDC radio connected. Use an OTG data cable.
